verificationMethod: Every entry was confirmed against the declared schema module AND against the live migrated database (information_schema / pg_policies / pg_trigger). Entries whose behaviour was not exercised end-to-end are marked classification REUSED_UNVERIFIED rather than COMPLETE.

dispositions.COMPLETE: Exists, is exercised by MCM read or write paths, and satisfies the mission requirement without further work.
dispositions.EXTENDED: Existed before MCM; this work added columns, policy, constraints or a service path.
dispositions.REUSED_UNCHANGED: Exists and is consumed by MCM exactly as-is; MCM adds no schema.
dispositions.REUSED_UNVERIFIED: Exists but is not yet exercised by any MCM path. Recorded honestly so it is not mistaken for delivered.
dispositions.MISSING_IMPLEMENTED: Did not exist; created by this work (migration 0076 / 0077).
dispositions.MISSING_DEFERRED: Does not exist and is deliberately not built, with the reason recorded.

assets.change: 0076 adds the parent-cycle guard trigger (beyu_mcm_assert_no_entity_cycle) and MCM consumes it as the single corporate registry. No column added: MCM profile facts live in legal_entity_profiles so the registry cannot be restated.
Tenant is the outer boundary of every MCM row. TENANT != LEGAL ENTITY != BUSINESS, and the RLS predicate is tenant-based while entity narrowing is ABAC.
MCM reads these; it never seeds a country or jurisdiction.
MCM READS ONLY. Ownership truth stays here; mcm:ownership.validate writes evidence to ownership_validations and never mutates this table. organization:ownership.manage remains unheld by every role.
Beneficial owners may be parties rather than entities; MCM resolves owner labels through these without creating a party.

New in 0076. Registration-verification evidence, reporting currency/timezone, statutory identifiers and obligations. Verified state is frozen by 0077's legal_entity_profiles_verified_immutable policy.
New in 0076. Append-only by trigger (UPDATE and DELETE both raise). DISSOLVED/ARCHIVED require an authority reference.
New in 0076. Effective-dated NON-OWNERSHIP relationships; the enum has no OWNERSHIP member and a CHECK refuses it. 0077 adds restrictive no-delete.
New in 0076. Per-rule findings (R1-R7) with totals; append-only by trigger.

The governance domain owns appointment, meeting and resolution authority. MCM presents them per company and cannot appoint a director or pass a resolution. /api/v1/mcm/governance reads through mcm:company.read.

Deliberately not built. Creating an appointment or a resolution is a governance act with its own authority chain, quorum rules and evidence requirements; duplicating it inside MCM would create a second, weaker governance engine.
CAP_POSTING remains LOCKED. MCM imports no Finance write path and writes no journal row from any of its services, routes or screens.

The intercompany service documents a period-lock precondition but the check is not yet wired to financial_periods; the database currently enforces currency/agreement consistency only. Recorded as a gap, not as delivered.
Read by entityFinancialSnapshots; every figure carries currency, period, source and data state, and degrades to RESTRICTED or UNAVAILABLE rather than zero.
New in 0076. Governed rate source for translation; runtime role is SELECT-only by grant and by restrictive policy.
New in 0076. Dual authorisation is a DB CHECK (distinct principals); an authorised transaction cannot be deleted; reconciliation is append-only.
New in 0076. Reviewer != preparer by CHECK; a REVIEWED run cannot be revised back to DRAFT; an applied adjustment is frozen.

The run/entity/adjustment records and their controls exist; the translation and elimination ENGINE that would populate totals from Finance OS balances is not implemented. No consolidated total is therefore ever fabricated — consolidation_runs totals stay null and render as UNAVAILABLE. This is the largest honest gap in the delivery.
New in 0076. Propose (mcm:capital.propose) is separated from decide (mcm:capital.approve, HIGH_RISK); approval requires a deciding body and a resolution reference.
New in 0076. Versioned, effective-dated per-country configuration. Runtime role has no write authority (read-only policy and grant); recording a version is an operator act.
New in 0076. filing_mode MANUAL / DOCUMENT_BASED / VERIFIED_API; a VERIFIED_API filing requires the authority's own acknowledgement reference. No regulator API is invented.

assets.asset: Tanzania country profile (BRELA / TRA / NSSF / WCF)
assets.change: No TZ profile row is seeded and no regulator integration is declared, because no verified machine interface exists for these four authorities in this repository. Filings execute through MANUAL or DOCUMENT_BASED workflows, which are implemented. Seeding authority names without a verified interface would be the exact invention the mission forbids.

New in 0076. Entity-scoped operating registers that POINT AT the canonical module (Foundation procurements, Ujenzi purchase orders, sector projects) rather than replacing it. These three keep DELETE on purpose: their drafts are operational, not evidence.
New in 0076. Allowlisted source_table, existence-checked target row, restrictive no-delete in 0077. This is how MCM is entity-aware without copying module truth.

assets.asset: risks / controls / compliance_obligations / compliance_assessments / legal_matters / contract_records / documents
assets.change: Read through riskComplianceOverview and role-restricted counts. MCM creates no risk, obligation or contract.
The MCM registers reference these by id. A Foundation-owned procurement must point at the Foundation model, preserving Foundation isolation.

MCM links to audit findings and objectives through mcm_module_links but exposes no dedicated internal-audit or EPM workspace. The link mechanism is implemented; the bespoke UI is not, and no KPI is fabricated in its place.

groups.title: HCM, Sector OS and NOELIA integration

assets.change: HCM remains the employee master. MCM shows per-entity headcount as an ACTUAL figure and creates no employee row.

New in 0076. The ONLY route by which MCM may receive another system's data. Declares owner, direction, exposed fields, classification ceiling and failure policy (default FAIL_CLOSED_UNAVAILABLE). Runtime role cannot insert or update a contract: verification is a human, privileged act.

assets.asset: HEALTH_OS / FINANCE_OS / AGRICULTURE_OS / UJENZI_OS service contracts
assets.change: MCM declares the contract shape but does not yet call each Sector OS service through it; sector figures are not surfaced on /os/mcm. Recorded as a gap rather than claimed as complete.
No NOELIA tool is registered for MCM, so NOELIA cannot read or act on MCM data at all. This is the fail-closed default; a read-only advisory tool with human approval remains to be added.

27 mcm:* permission codes added; 4 marked HIGH_RISK; 3 added to ADMIN_DELEGATABLE. GROUP_CEO deliberately lacks mcm:consolidation.review and mcm:intercompany.authorize so four-eyes holds by construction.
The single authorization primitive, reused. Every MCM service re-derives scope and refuses an entity outside it; a permission alone is never sufficient.

ENABLE + FORCE RLS, permissive tenant_scope, restrictive no-delete on thirteen evidence tables, restrictive no-write on reference configuration. Proven with the actual beyu_runtime role in tests/mcm/rls-isolation.test.ts.
All 20 tables classified; audit-runtime-privileges reports failures: [].
Inside the one BEYU OS shell, guarded by mcm:company.read, deriving every panel from one visibleEntities() resolution. No new login, no new OS.
Added to the Executive group. Three pinned IA tests updated deliberately rather than loosened.

assets.asset: MCM mutation UI (forms for profile, lifecycle, intercompany, filings)
assets.change: The command centre is read-only. Every mutation exists as an authorized API route but has no in-product form yet; adding forms without an approval UI for the high-risk acts would let a four-eyes decision look single-click.

summary.note: Counts are derived from the dispositions above so they cannot drift from the entries. Deferred items are stated explicitly rather than omitted: no reader may mistake an unbuilt capability for a delivered one.
